sources.title: PHEV Watchdog Lite 1.9.1.2023OCT29 APK string/DB-schema analysis
sources.description: Independent reverse-engineering of vehicle model constants, SQLite field names and battery/cell telemetry schema from the PHEV Watchdog Lite Android APK. No proprietary binary payloads or encrypted databases copied.
sources.notes: Field names reflect what the app stores/displays. They are not yet mapped to concrete CAN IDs, OBD PIDs or UDS DIDs.

notes: Initial seed from PHEV Watchdog Lite reverse-engineering. All entries UNVERIFIED. No CAN/PID/DID requests invented.
